ValidationRule.description: Prevent non system user from updating the names on Contact Non-Authenticated Caller and Contact Non-Affiliate Caller.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: (Id= $CustomMetadata.Live_Agent_Setting__mdt.Non_Authenticated_CallerId.Value__c || Id = '0036T000043oON7' ) && ( ISCHANGED( FirstName) || ISCHANGED (LastName) || ISCHANGED ( Middle_Name__c ) ) && $Profile.Id <> '00ed00000017Iob'
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Only System Administrator can change the contact names on Non-Authenticated Caller and Non-Affiliate Caller.
